# anywhere

> Macのフタを閉じてもスリープさせず、Claude Code・ビルド・ダウンロードなどのジョブを走らせ続ける無料のメニューバーアプリ。外部ディスプレイや電源接続は不要で、バッテリー駆動のまま動作します。指定した時間が来ると自動でOFFになり、元のスリープ設定に完全に復元されます。macOS 13+（Apple Silicon / Intel）と Windows 10/11 に対応。MITライセンスのオープンソースソフトウェアです。

anywhere is a free, open-source (MIT) menu-bar / system-tray app that keeps a
laptop working with the lid closed — on battery, no external display required.
Pick a duration (30m / 1h / 2h), close the lid, and long-running jobs (Claude
Code sessions, builds, crawlers, downloads) keep running; when the timer ends,
the original sleep settings are restored automatically. Developed by Qurio Inc.

## How it works

- macOS: menu-bar app; toggles lid-close sleep via a tightly-scoped
  passwordless-sudo rule for `pmset -a disablesleep` (installed once with an
  admin prompt), and blocks idle sleep with `caffeinate`.
- Windows: system-tray app; overrides the power scheme's lid-close action via
  elevated Scheduled Tasks registered once (single UAC prompt), and blocks
  idle sleep with `SetThreadExecutionState`. The original setting is backed up
  and restored on OFF.
- Auto-off: an optional timer turns the mode off and restores everything, so
  a forgotten session cannot drain the battery overnight.
